title: Extended $\mathcal{O}$-operators, extended perm Yang-Baxter equations and related structures
summary: In this paper, we introduce the notions of extended $\mathcal{O}$-operators on perm algebras, as generalization of $\mathcal{O}$-operators, and the extended perm Yang-Baxter equation. We demonstrate that an $\mathcal{O}$-operator of weight $λ$ on a perm algebra gives rise to a post-perm algebra, and an extended $\mathcal{O}$-operator yields a new perm algebra structure. We also give an equivalent characterization of extended $\mathcal{O}$-operators in terms of ordinary $\mathcal{O}$-operators via the $π_\pm$ decomposition.
